strategy.heading: Where the first followers will come from
items: • Neighbours who pick up their boxes and tag the bakery.

strategy.heading: Rhythm
items: • Six posts a week, Monday to Saturday, at 7:30 a.m.
• Thirty posts in five weeks, from 2 November 2026.
• Every post ends with one clear next step: the pre-order link or the word LOAF in a direct message.

strategy.heading: Targets and review
items: • 300 followers and 40 Loaf Box pre-orders by the end of week five.
• If fewer than 15 pre-orders come in by the end of week three, move one reel a week to the Loaf Box rubric.
